source: docs/results.md, generated by make experiment on 2026-10-16

groups.title: Normal days
groups.verdict: No harm: when nothing was sold out, B forecasts the same as A.

groups.title: Right after a stockout
groups.detail: 88 series with a stockout in the last 14 days, stress test
groups.verdict: B is 3.4 points closer (95% interval +0.2 to +7.3) and stays ahead with the estimated ask rate shifted by -50% or +50%.

groups.title: Coconut milk, sold out 14 days
groups.verdict: A reads the empty shelf as no demand and forecasts 71% too low; B is 13% too low.

note: Simulated data with known true demand; lower WAPE is better. A plain 28-day average scores 56.0% on normal days, so B is not a better forecaster in general: it keeps the forecast from collapsing after a stockout.
